name: aviation
conventions: The catalog version of the aviation schema (SCHEMA.md section 16) installed into tenant 0 as catalog version 1, as CATALOG.md lays it out, read through its decoder. "fixed" is the version's fixed part without checksum and magic; "entries" is the entry table in order, each entry its kind, its name, its fixed part ("fixed") and its sections ("sections") under CATALOG.md section 5's field names, the two string sections left out since every string is given as its text. A string is its text and ABSENT is null, for a u32 field as for a string; a u8 boolean is true or false; a u8 code or flag set is its number; a u64 past 2^53 is a decimal string. A type descriptor is its tag with the arguments the tag uses, a descriptor index among them given as that descriptor and a qualified name as its text; a constant is its type and its text; a program is its record with its instructions, which tile the instructions section in program order, each its op's name with its x and arg where the op has them, a string arg as its text and a constant arg as the constant. A type table, constants and programs section lists its records in their order, in these forms. The Source entry's text is the bytes of the file it names. Entry offsets, lengths and the checksum are pinned once a decode of the compiled version matches this file (SCHEMA.md section 10.2, rule 6).
